text:
Asking rents in Leipzig stand at a median of 10.00 €/m² (2026-06), up 1.5% on the year and +30.7% over five years. That ranks Leipzig #23 of 37 cities; new lets are priced 55% above the 2022 average contract rent of 6.44 €/m².

A 60 m² flat costs about 600 € a month in cold rent, 15.2% of the disposable income of two residents. Listings stay online for about 31 days and 26% are gone within a week; with 2.2% market-active vacancy and +5.7% population growth over five years, the market looks tight.

The model estimate for twelve months ahead is 10.67 €/m² (+6.7%), with an 80% range of 10.33 to 10.99 €/m²; housing-loan rates are at 4.01%.
